question: I'm a CS 5th-year student. I've completed 15-112 (Fundamentals of Programming, grade: B) and 21-127 (Concepts of Mathematics, grade: C). I haven't taken 15-151. Can I register for 15-150 (Principles of Functional Programming)?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-150 requires (15-151 at least C OR 21-127 at least C OR 21-128 at least C) AND (15-112 at least C). P-009 has 15-112 with a B (satisfies the second condition) and 21-127 with a C (satisfies the first condition). 15-151 is not required because 21-127 is an accepted alternative.
common_mistake: Assuming 15-151 is required when 21-127 serves as an accepted alternative; missing that both the math prereq AND 15-112 must be satisfied simultaneously
needs_verification: Confirm P-009's grades in 15-112 (need C+) and 21-127 (need C+)
Confirm P-009 hasn't already completed 15-150 (appears they have, in Fall 2023 — this question may need rephrasing for an earlier time point)
Confirm the current prereq text for 15-150 still accepts 21-127 as alternative to 15-151
